I am an old man in Somalie, and the land here is dry. The rains come late and sometimes not at all, so putting expensive fertilizer on maize is a risk I cannot take on this small plot. I will plant my own seed that I saved from last year, and use the manure from my animals since that costs nothing. My sons and I will do the work ourselves; hiring people is not something a man with only 0.30 hectares of maize can afford.
